root_causes.cause: Revision 2 changed PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999 (payment serves on 8080). Checkout's Charge gRPC dials time out, which fails PlaceOrder with Unavailable and drives the ~37% error ratio. Rolling back to revision 1 should restore service.
